# types

```go
import types "ganigeorgiev.com/pocketbase/pocketbase/tools/types"
```

Package types implements some commonly used db serializable types like datetime, json, etc.

Source: [`tools/types`](https://github.com/pocketonehq/pocketone/tree/main/tools/types).

## Constants

<a id="defaultdatelayout"></a>

```go
const DefaultDateLayout = "2006-01-02 15:04:05.000Z"
```

DefaultDateLayout specifies the default app date strings layout.

## Functions

### Pointer

```go
func Pointer[T any](val T) *T
```

Pointer is a generic helper that returns val as \*T.

## Types

### DateTime

```go
type DateTime struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

DateTime represents a [time.Time](/time#Time) instance in UTC that is wrapped and serialized using the app default date layout.

### NowDateTime

```go
func NowDateTime() DateTime
```

NowDateTime returns new DateTime instance with the current local time.

### ParseDateTime

```go
func ParseDateTime(value any) (DateTime, error)
```

ParseDateTime creates a new DateTime from the provided value (could be [cast.ToTime](/github.com/spf13/cast#ToTime) supported string, [time.Time](/time#Time), etc.).

### DateTime.Add

```go
func (d DateTime) Add(duration time.Duration) DateTime
```

Add returns a new DateTime based on the current DateTime + the specified duration.

### DateTime.AddDate

```go
func (d DateTime) AddDate(years, months, days int) DateTime
```

AddDate returns a new DateTime based on the current one + duration.

It follows the same rules as [time.AddDate](/time#AddDate).

### DateTime.After

```go
func (d DateTime) After(u DateTime) bool
```

After reports whether the current DateTime instance is after u.

### DateTime.Before

```go
func (d DateTime) Before(u DateTime) bool
```

Before reports whether the current DateTime instance is before u.

### DateTime.Compare

```go
func (d DateTime) Compare(u DateTime) int
```

Compare compares the current DateTime instance with u. If the current instance is before u, it returns -1. If the current instance is after u, it returns +1. If they're the same, it returns 0.

### DateTime.Equal

```go
func (d DateTime) Equal(u DateTime) bool
```

Equal reports whether the current DateTime and u represent the same time instant. Two DateTime can be equal even if they are in different locations. For example, 6:00 +0200 and 4:00 UTC are Equal.

### DateTime.IsZero

```go
func (d DateTime) IsZero() bool
```

IsZero checks whether the current DateTime instance has zero time value.

### DateTime.MarshalJSON

```go
func (d DateTime) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
```

MarshalJSON implements the [json.Marshaler](/encoding/json/v2#Marshaler) interface.

### DateTime.Scan

```go
func (d *DateTime) Scan(value any) error
```

Scan implements \[sql.Scanner] interface to scan the provided value into the current DateTime instance.

### DateTime.String

```go
func (d DateTime) String() string
```

String serializes the current DateTime instance into a formatted UTC date string.

The zero value is serialized to an empty string.

### DateTime.Sub

```go
func (d DateTime) Sub(u DateTime) time.Duration
```

Sub returns a [time.Duration](/time#Duration) by subtracting the specified DateTime from the current one.

If the result exceeds the maximum (or minimum) value that can be stored in a [time.Duration](/time#Duration), the maximum (or minimum) duration will be returned.

### DateTime.Time

```go
func (d DateTime) Time() time.Time
```

Time returns the internal [time.Time](/time#Time) instance.

### DateTime.Unix

```go
func (d DateTime) Unix() int64
```

Unix returns the current DateTime as a Unix time, aka. the number of seconds elapsed since January 1, 1970 UTC.

### DateTime.UnmarshalJSON

```go
func (d *DateTime) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error
```

UnmarshalJSON implements the [json.Unmarshaler](/encoding/json/v2#Unmarshaler) interface.

### DateTime.Value

```go
func (d DateTime) Value() (driver.Value, error)
```

Value implements the [driver.Valuer](/database/sql/driver#Valuer) interface.

### GeoPoint

```go
type GeoPoint struct {
	Lon float64 `form:"lon" json:"lon"`
	Lat float64 `form:"lat" json:"lat"`
}
```

GeoPoint defines a struct for storing geo coordinates as serialized json object (e.g. {lon:0,lat:0}).

Note: using object notation and not a plain array to avoid the confusion as there doesn't seem to be a fixed standard for the coordinates order.

### GeoPoint.AsMap

```go
func (p GeoPoint) AsMap() map[string]any
```

AsMap implements \[core.mapExtractor] and returns a value suitable to be used in an API rule expression.

### GeoPoint.Scan

```go
func (p *GeoPoint) Scan(value any) error
```

Scan implements \[sql.Scanner] interface to scan the provided value into the current GeoPoint instance.

The value argument could be nil (no-op), another GeoPoint instance, map or serialized json object with lat-lon props.

### GeoPoint.String

```go
func (p GeoPoint) String() string
```

String returns the string representation of the current GeoPoint instance.

### GeoPoint.Value

```go
func (p GeoPoint) Value() (driver.Value, error)
```

Value implements the [driver.Valuer](/database/sql/driver#Valuer) interface.

### JSONMap

```go
type JSONMap[T any] map[string]T
```

JSONMap defines a map that is safe for json and db read/write.

### JSONMap.Get

```go
func (m JSONMap[T]) Get(key string) T
```

Get retrieves a single value from the current JSONMap\[T].

This helper was added primarily to assist the goja integration since custom map types don't have direct access to the map keys ([https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/dop251/goja#hdr-Maps\_with\_methods](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/dop251/goja#hdr-Maps_with_methods)).

### JSONMap.MarshalJSON

```go
func (m JSONMap[T]) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error)
```

MarshalJSON implements the [json.Marshaler](/encoding/json/v2#Marshaler) interface.

### JSONMap.Scan

```go
func (m *JSONMap[T]) Scan(value any) error
```

Scan implements \[sql.Scanner] interface to scan the provided value into the current JSONMap\[T] instance.

### JSONMap.Set

```go
func (m JSONMap[T]) Set(key string, value T)
```

Set sets a single value in the current JSONMap\[T].

This helper was added primarily to assist the goja integration since custom map types don't have direct access to the map keys ([https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/dop251/goja#hdr-Maps\_with\_methods](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/dop251/goja#hdr-Maps_with_methods)).

### JSONMap.String

```go
func (m JSONMap[T]) String() string
```

String returns the string representation of the current json map.

### JSONMap.Value

```go
func (m JSONMap[T]) Value() (driver.Value, error)
```

Value implements the [driver.Valuer](/database/sql/driver#Valuer) interface.
